answer: The RBI's current repo rate is 5.50 percent, set by a 25 basis point hike in October 2026 [3]. This was the first repo rate hike since February 2023 [4]. The Monetary Policy Committee changed its policy stance to 'calibrated tightening' from 'neutral' [4].
